audience: teachers and trainers who give online tests and exams with ClassMarker

useCases.title: List our groups, links and exams
useCases.text: Lists the groups, links and exams the account can access, with the ids other tools need, including access-code lists for links.

useCases.title: Read recent finished test results
useCases.text: Reads recent finished results with name, score, percentage and pass or fail, across all groups or links or for one exam, a page at a time.

useCases.title: Browse the question bank
useCases.text: Lists question categories and questions, with text, type, category, points and correct options, and reads one question by id.

useCases.title: Add access codes to a link's list
useCases.text: Adds up to 100 access codes per call to the access-code list of a link, so those people can start the exam.

useCases.title: Create or update a question
useCases.text: Reads a question first, then adds a new multiple choice, multiple response, true or false or essay question, or replaces an existing one.

useCases.title: Create, rename or move question categories
useCases.text: Creates parent categories and categories under them, and renames them or moves a category to another parent.
